hypotheses.justification: Lean includes this instance automatically because it mentions only 𝔏, which is an argument via `pts`. The `omit` line does not remove it. Nothing in the statement needs it. The monoid structure on `WithConv (HO →ₐ[O] 𝔏)` (Mathlib `RingTheory/Bialgebra/Convolution.lean`) needs only `CommSemiring 𝔏` (from `Field 𝔏`), `Algebra O 𝔏` and a bialgebra structure on `HO` (from `HopfAlgebra O HO`). The proof is `pts.injective` together with `pts (f^k) = k • pts f`, `pts 1 = 0` and `card_nsmul_eq_zero'` (`Nat.card M • a = 0` in any group; if M is infinite, `Nat.card M = 0`). The helper lemmas `pts_one` and `pts_pow` currently take this instance, but their proofs use only `hadd`, `one_mul`, `add_left_cancel`, `pow_zero`, `zero_nsmul`, `pow_succ` and `succ_nsmul`. They can be inlined, or the helpers given the same `omit`. It can be deleted on its own or together with `[CharZero 𝔏]`.

Lean includes this instance automatically because it mentions only 𝔏, which is an argument via `pts`. The `omit` line does not remove it. Nothing in the statement or the argument needs it. The convolution monoid on `WithConv (HO →ₐ[O] 𝔏)` needs only `CommSemiring 𝔏` and `Algebra O 𝔏` (plus a bialgebra structure on `HO`). The proof is `pts.injective`, the homomorphism identities `pts 1 = 0` and `pts (f^k) = k • pts f` (proved from `hadd` alone by `add_left_cancel` and induction), and `card_nsmul_eq_zero'`, which holds in any additive group, including when `Nat.card M = 0`. The helpers `pts_one` and `pts_pow` currently take this instance, so either inline their short proofs or add the same `omit` to them. It can be deleted on its own or together with `[IsAlgClosed 𝔏]`.
